name: GCL System Integration Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: GCL System Integration Technology Co., Ltd. provides comprehensive energy systems in China and internationally. It offers PV modules, utility scale ESS, and utility EMS modules; and C and I and utility solutions. The company's portfolio covers wind power, PV power, energy storage, hydrogen energy, and optimization of source grid-oad-storage topology of new-energy network. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Suzhou, China.
